newsitem.title: USA: Jacksonville, Fla., tax base rises by $1 Billion.
newsitem.headline: Jacksonville, Fla., tax base rises by $1 Billion.

text.p: The value of taxable property in Jacksonville, Fla., rose by about $1 billion, or 4.5 percent, to $24.04 billion this year, the Jacksonville Times-Union said Thursday.
The increase translates to an annual revenue increase of about $11 million. The budget for the current year, which ends Sept 30, is $551 million.
The increase will allow Mayor John Delaney to propose a small cut in the property tax rate when he introduces his fiscal 1998 budget next month, the newspaper said.
